## tests/test_create.py

### A new contact is saved and given back with id 1

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann Lee', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme', status='customer') is called
- then it has status 201, body {'id': 1, 'name': 'Ann Lee', 'email': 'ann@x.io', 'company': 'Acme', 'status': 'customer'}

### The answer says where the new contact lives

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io') is called
- then it has location '/api/contacts/1'

### Ids count up from 1

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- then it has status 201, location '/api/contacts/2'
- crm.body["id"] should be 2

### Company and status are optional

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io') is called
- then it has status 201
- crm.body["company"] should be None
- crm.body["status"] should be 'lead'

### An empty company is saved as no company

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='   ') is called
- then it has status 201
- crm.body["company"] should be None

### Spaces around fields are removed

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='  Ann Lee ', email=' ann@x.io ', company=' Acme ') is called
- then it has status 201
- crm.body["name"] should be 'Ann Lee'
- crm.body["email"] should be 'ann@x.io'
- crm.body["company"] should be 'Acme'

### Emails are saved in lowercase

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='Ann.Lee@Example.COM') is called
- crm.body["email"] should be 'ann.lee@example.com'

### Fields the crm does not know are ignored

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', age=42) is called
- then it has status 201
- crm.body should not contain 'age'

### A new contact can be read back

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and get('/api/contacts/1') is called
- then it has status 200, body {'id': 1, 'name': 'Ann', 'email': 'ann@x.io', 'company': 'Acme', 'status': 'lead'}

## tests/test_edit.py

### An unknown contact is not found and the answer is json

- given a CRM
- when get('/api/contacts/99') is called
- then it has status 404, error 'not found'
- when patch('/api/contacts/99', name='Zed') is called
- then it has status 404, error 'not found'
- when delete('/api/contacts/99') is called
- then it has status 404, error 'not found'

### Only the fields sent are changed

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and patch('/api/contacts/1', status='customer') is called
- then it has status 200, body {'id': 1, 'name': 'Ann', 'email': 'ann@x.io', 'company': 'Acme', 'status': 'customer'}

### A change is kept

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and patch('/api/contacts/1', name='Ann Lee', company='Initech') is called
- and get('/api/contacts/1') is called
- crm.body["name"] should be 'Ann Lee'
- crm.body["company"] should be 'Initech'

### A change follows the same rules as a new contact

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and patch('/api/contacts/1', name=' ', email='nope', status='vip') is called
- then it has status 400, errors {'name': 'is required', 'email': 'is not a valid email', 'status': 'is not a valid status'}

### A refused change changes nothing

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and patch('/api/contacts/1', name='Ann Lee', email='nope') is called
- and get('/api/contacts/1') is called
- crm.body["name"] should be 'Ann'

### A contact can keep its own email

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and patch('/api/contacts/1', email='ANN@x.io', name='Ann Lee') is called
- then it has status 200
- crm.body["email"] should be 'ann@x.io'

### A contact cannot take another contacts email

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and patch('/api/contacts/2', email='Ann@X.io') is called
- then it has status 409, error 'email already exists'

### The id cannot be changed

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and patch('/api/contacts/1', id=7, name='Ann Lee') is called
- then it has status 200
- crm.body["id"] should be 1
- when get('/api/contacts/7') is called
- then it has status 404

### A deleted contact is gone

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and delete('/api/contacts/1') is called
- then it has status 204, page ''
- when get('/api/contacts/1') is called
- then it has status 404
- when get('/api/contacts') is called
- then it has names ['Bob']

### A deleted email can be used again

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and delete('/api/contacts/1') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='New Ann', email='ann@x.io') is called
- then it has status 201

## tests/test_list.py

### A new crm has no contacts

- given a CRM
- when get('/api/contacts') is called
- then it has status 200, body {'contacts': []}

### Contacts are listed by name ignoring case

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='carla Diaz', email='carla@globex.com', company='Globex', status='customer') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Ann Lee', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme', status='lead') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob Stone', email='bob@acme.com', status='lost') is called
- and get('/api/contacts') is called
- then it has status 200, names ['Ann Lee', 'Bob Stone', 'carla Diaz']

### Search looks in name email and company ignoring case

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='carla Diaz', email='carla@globex.com', company='Globex', status='customer') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Ann Lee', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme', status='lead') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob Stone', email='bob@acme.com', status='lost') is called
- and get('/api/contacts', q='ACME') is called
- then it has status 200, names ['Ann Lee', 'Bob Stone']
- when get('/api/contacts', q='diaz') is called
- then it has names ['carla Diaz']
- when get('/api/contacts', q='@x.io') is called
- then it has names ['Ann Lee']

### A search that matches nothing gives an empty list

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='carla Diaz', email='carla@globex.com', company='Globex', status='customer') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Ann Lee', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme', status='lead') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob Stone', email='bob@acme.com', status='lost') is called
- and get('/api/contacts', q='zebra') is called
- then it has status 200, names []

### Contacts can be filtered by status

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='carla Diaz', email='carla@globex.com', company='Globex', status='customer') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Ann Lee', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme', status='lead') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob Stone', email='bob@acme.com', status='lost') is called
- and get('/api/contacts', status='customer') is called
- then it has status 200, names ['carla Diaz']
- when get('/api/contacts', status='lead') is called
- then it has names ['Ann Lee']

### Search and status filter work together

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='carla Diaz', email='carla@globex.com', company='Globex', status='customer') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Ann Lee', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme', status='lead') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob Stone', email='bob@acme.com', status='lost') is called
- and get('/api/contacts', q='acme', status='lost') is called
- then it has status 200, names ['Bob Stone']

### An unknown status filter is refused

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='carla Diaz', email='carla@globex.com', company='Globex', status='customer') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Ann Lee', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme', status='lead') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob Stone', email='bob@acme.com', status='lost') is called
- and get('/api/contacts', status='vip') is called
- then it has status 400, error 'unknown status'

## tests/test_page.py

### An empty crm says so

- given a CRM
- when get('/') is called
- then it has status 200
- crm.page should contain 'No contacts yet'

### The page lists names and companies in name order

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Bob Stone', email='bob@x.io', company='Globex') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Ann Lee', email='ann@x.io', company='Acme') is called
- and get('/') is called
- then it has status 200
- crm.page should contain 'Ann Lee'
- crm.page should contain 'Acme'
- crm.page should not contain 'No contacts yet'
- crm.page should match /(?s)Ann Lee.*Bob Stone/

### Names and companies are escaped

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='<b>Bo</b>', email='bo@x.io', company='<script>x()</script>') is called
- and get('/') is called
- crm.page should contain '&lt;b&gt;Bo&lt;/b&gt;'
- crm.page should not contain '<script>x()</script>'

## tests/test_pipeline.py

### A new crm counts zero at every stage

- given a CRM
- when get('/api/pipeline') is called
- then it has status 200, body {'lead': 0, 'customer': 0, 'lost': 0}

### Each contact is counted at its stage

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io', status='customer') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Cy', email='cy@x.io', status='customer') is called
- and get('/api/pipeline') is called
- then it has body {'lead': 1, 'customer': 2, 'lost': 0}

### The counts follow changes and deletes

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Bob', email='bob@x.io') is called
- and patch('/api/contacts/1', status='lost') is called
- and delete('/api/contacts/2') is called
- and get('/api/pipeline') is called
- then it has body {'lead': 0, 'customer': 0, 'lost': 1}

## tests/test_validation.py

### Name and email are required

- add_contact: if email='ann@x.io', then give (400, {'errors': {'name': 'is required'}})
- add_contact: if name='Ann', then give (400, {'errors': {'email': 'is required'}})
- add_contact: if name='   ', email='ann@x.io', then give (400, {'errors': {'name': 'is required'}})
- add_contact: if name='', email='', then give (400, {'errors': {'name': 'is required', 'email': 'is required'}})

### A name can be 100 characters but not 101

- add_contact: if name='<100 × x>', email='ann@x.io', then give (201, {'id': 1, 'name': '<100 × x>', 'email': 'ann@x.io', 'company': None, 'status': 'lead'})
- add_contact: if name='<101 × x>', email='ann@x.io', then give (400, {'errors': {'name': 'is too long'}})

### A name is measured after removing spaces

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name=' <100 × x> ', email='ann@x.io') is called
- then it has status 201

### A company can be 100 characters but not 101

- add_contact: if name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', company='<101 × c>', then give (400, {'errors': {'company': 'is too long'}})

### An email must look like an email

- add_contact: if name='Ann', email='ann', then give (400, {'errors': {'email': 'is not a valid email'}})
- add_contact: if name='Ann', email='ann@', then give (400, {'errors': {'email': 'is not a valid email'}})
- add_contact: if name='Ann', email='@x.io', then give (400, {'errors': {'email': 'is not a valid email'}})
- add_contact: if name='Ann', email='ann@x', then give (400, {'errors': {'email': 'is not a valid email'}})
- add_contact: if name='Ann', email='ann lee@x.io', then give (400, {'errors': {'email': 'is not a valid email'}})
- add_contact: if name='Ann', email='ann@@x.io', then give (400, {'errors': {'email': 'is not a valid email'}})

### Ordinary emails are accepted

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io') is called
- then it has status 201
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann.lee+crm@mail.example.com') is called
- then it has status 201
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='a_b-c@x-y.co') is called
- then it has status 201

### Status must be lead customer or lost

- add_contact: if name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', status='vip', then give (400, {'errors': {'status': 'is not a valid status'}})
- add_contact: if name='Ann', email='ann@x.io', status='Customer', then give (400, {'errors': {'status': 'is not a valid status'}})

### Every invalid field is reported at once

- add_contact: if name='', email='nope', status='vip', then give (400, {'errors': {'name': 'is required', 'email': 'is not a valid email', 'status': 'is not a valid status'}})

### A body that is not a json object is refused

- given a CRM
- when post_body('/api/contacts', 'not json') is called
- then it has status 400, error 'expected a JSON object'
- when post_body('/api/contacts', '["Ann", "ann@x.io"]') is called
- then it has status 400, error 'expected a JSON object'

### An email can only be used once ignoring case

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='Ann@X.io') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Other Ann', email='ann@x.io') is called
- then it has status 409, error 'email already exists'

### A refused contact is not saved

- given a CRM
- when post('/api/contacts', name='', email='ann@x.io') is called
- and post('/api/contacts', name='Ann', email='ann@x.io') is called
- then it has status 201, location '/api/contacts/1'
- when get('/api/contacts') is called
- then it has names ['Ann']
